app.name: Claude Reply Drafts
app.short_description: Draft replies in Claude Desktop and insert them into the ticket reply
app.long_description: Opens Claude Desktop from a ticket with a request to draft a reply, then shows the draft posted by zendesk_mcp_server's add_internal_note (kind: draft) in the sidebar. The draft can be inserted into the reply with one click.
app.installation_instructions: Install the zendesk_mcp_server extension in each agent's Claude Desktop and turn on internal note posting (enable_sensitive_writes).

prompt_template.label: Request to Claude
prompt_template.helpText: Text placed in Claude Desktop's input. {{ticket_id}} is replaced with the ticket number. Only the number is passed, so ticket contents never bypass the MCP server's PII masking.

draft_marker.label: Draft marker
draft_marker.helpText: Internal notes starting with this text are treated as drafts. Must match the MCP server's marker.

claude_project_url.label: Claude project URL (optional)
claude_project_url.helpText: In the form https://claude.ai/project/... . When set, the button opens this project and copies the request to the clipboard (project links cannot prefill the input). When empty, a new chat opens with the request prefilled. Agents can override it in the sidebar.
